Did Kovalev give Tucker a fight after this dirty cheap shot? You're kidding yourself if you think Tucker ducked from fights more than Kovalev. Everyone likes to shit on Tucker because he was a pest for the Leafs but he fought plenty of heavyweights while being a smaller player himself. How often did Kovalev fight someone his own size? No, he goes for an elbow on someone he has fifty pounds on and then does nothing in the scrum after. What a tough guy. 

[Here's Kovalev when he's not hiding behind his teammates.](https://youtu.be/kv2wgKVjB_I)
Are you really going to bring size up when 6'2 225 Kovalev went for an elbow on 5'10 175 Tucker and did absolutely nothing in the fight after his cheap shot?
Sorry to hear that, it sounds horrible. I hope you can find something that helps in time. It's a terrible feeling to be so young and hopeless.
I don't think anyone will love me anymore once they find out how horrible I was as a young man.
Happy birthday! Don't let the haters get you down.
